svg.title: The seven embedding vectors, followed through training, in 64 independent runs.
svg.desc: Each path is the displacement E e_a(t) − E e_a(0) ∈ ℝ⁸ of one character's embedding over 200 steps (AdamW, η 0.02 → 0.002 (warmup 20, cosine), β₂ 0.95, weight decay 0.01 on matrices, clip 1; seeds 1–64), projected onto the plane of the two leading singular vectors of that run's final displacement and scaled so its longest final displacement reaches the rim. In value ink: one run (seed 1).
